verdict.rationale: Capacities' own developer docs say the successor API portal (developers.capacities.io) has a section on "SDKs" and offers "TypeScript SDK sample[s]" alongside an interactive OpenAPI spec. That is a first-party SDK claim, but it is only a passing mention; the rest of the evidence covers the REST API, the OpenAPI spec and MCP, not SDKs themselves. missing for 10: named or published SDK packages (e.g. an npm package) with install and usage docs, SDKs for languages beyond TypeScript, versioning and maintenance details, hands-on or independent corroboration that the SDK works.
